name: assinafy-wordpress-plugin
description: Local development harness for the Assinafy WordPress plugin. No build step: the plugin ships hand-written CSS and JS.

scripts.makepot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/assinafy wp i18n make-pot . languages/assinafy.pot --exclude=vendor,vendor-prefixed,node_modules,build,dist,tests,addons,.cache
scripts.test:php:ajax: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/assinafy vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --group ajax
